		add = -15
	}
}
qpq_sanctioned_conquest_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_sanctioned_conquest_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_sanctioned_conquest_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_sanctioned_conquest_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_sanctioned_conquest_ask_value
	add = qpq_sanctioned_conquest_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_opinion_points_value
	add = qpq_sanctioned_conquest_character_value
	add = qpq_sanctioned_conquest_dread_value
	add = qpq_sanctioned_conquest_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_sanctioned_conquest_goal_value
	add = qpq_sanctioned_conquest_refusal_value
}

qpq_sanctioned_conquest_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 18
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 10
	}
	add = {
		value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
		multiply = -0.2
		min = -15
		max = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
		}
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { top_liege = { any_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = { this = scope:secondary_recipient.top_liege } } }
		}
		add = 10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { any_claim = { holder ?= scope:secondary_recipient } } }
		add = 12
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 1.3 } } }
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 1.8 } } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength < { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 0.6 } } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_at_war = yes } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = ambitious } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = brave } }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = wrathful } }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = content } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = craven } }
		add = -10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
		add = -3
	}
}

#### Marcher Charge
qpq_marcher_charge_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_marcher_charge_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_marcher_charge_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_marcher_charge_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_marcher_charge_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_marcher_charge_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 50
	}
	add = 10
	multiply = {
		value = 1
		subtract = { value = qpq_marcher_charge_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
		min = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_marcher_charge_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_marcher_charge_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -5
}
qpq_marcher_charge_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_marcher_charge_demand_value
}
qpq_marcher_charge_offer_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes }
			add = qpq_marcher_charge_gold_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }
			add = -3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
			add = -5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_land ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_land_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_office ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_office_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_release_hook ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_release_hook_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_my_word_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_secret ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_secret_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_contract_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 70
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_marcher_charge_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_marcher_charge_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_marcher_charge_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_marcher_charge_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_marcher_charge_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_marcher_charge_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_marcher_charge_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_marcher_charge_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}

	value = 0
}
qpq_marcher_charge_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_marcher_charge_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_marcher_charge_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}

#### Holy Sponsorship
qpq_holy_sponsorship_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:target.holder }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_holy_sponsorship_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:target.holder }

			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_holy_sponsorship_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_holy_sponsorship_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_holy_sponsorship_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_holy_sponsorship_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 50
	}
	add = 10
	multiply = {
		value = 1
		subtract = { value = qpq_holy_sponsorship_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
		min = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_holy_sponsorship_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_holy_sponsorship_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -5
}
qpq_holy_sponsorship_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_holy_sponsorship_demand_value
}
qpq_holy_sponsorship_offer_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes }
			add = qpq_holy_sponsorship_gold_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }
			add = -3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
			add = -5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_land ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_land_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_office ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_office_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_release_hook ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_release_hook_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_my_word_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_secret ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_secret_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_contract_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 70
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_holy_sponsorship_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_holy_sponsorship_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_holy_sponsorship_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_holy_sponsorship_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_holy_sponsorship_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_holy_sponsorship_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_holy_sponsorship_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_holy_sponsorship_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_holy_sponsorship_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_holy_sponsorship_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_holy_sponsorship_agent_tier_value }
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_holy_sponsorship_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_holy_sponsorship_ask_value
	add = qpq_holy_sponsorship_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_opinion_points_value
	add = qpq_holy_sponsorship_character_value
	add = qpq_holy_sponsorship_dread_value
	add = qpq_holy_sponsorship_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_holy_sponsorship_goal_value
	add = qpq_holy_sponsorship_refusal_value
}

qpq_holy_sponsorship_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith } }
		add = -12
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = excommunicated } }
		add = -15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { piety_level >= 3 } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = zealous } }
		add = 4
	}
}

qpq_holy_sponsorship_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith } }
		add = -12
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = excommunicated } }
		add = -15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { piety_level >= 3 } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = zealous } }
		add = 4
	}
}

#### Development Charter
qpq_development_charter_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:target.holder }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_development_charter_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:target.holder }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}

	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_electoral_purchase_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_electoral_purchase_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_electoral_purchase_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_electoral_purchase_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_electoral_purchase_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_electoral_purchase_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_electoral_purchase_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_electoral_purchase_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_electoral_purchase_ask_value
	add = qpq_electoral_purchase_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_opinion_points_value
	add = qpq_electoral_purchase_character_value
	add = qpq_electoral_purchase_dread_value
	add = qpq_electoral_purchase_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_electoral_purchase_goal_value
	add = qpq_electoral_purchase_refusal_value
}

qpq_electoral_purchase_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	add = {
		value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
		multiply = 0.2
		min = -15
		max = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
		}
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 12
	}
}

qpq_electoral_purchase_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	add = {
		value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
		multiply = 0.2
		min = -15
		max = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
		}
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 12
	}
}

#### The Loyal Mole
qpq_loyal_mole_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_loyal_mole_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_loyal_mole_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_loyal_mole_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_loyal_mole_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_loyal_mole_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 50
	}
	add = 10
	multiply = {
		value = 1
		subtract = { value = qpq_loyal_mole_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
		min = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_loyal_mole_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_loyal_mole_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -10
}
qpq_loyal_mole_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_loyal_mole_demand_value
}
qpq_loyal_mole_offer_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes }
			add = qpq_loyal_mole_gold_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }
			add = -3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
			add = -5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_land ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_land_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_office ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_office_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_release_hook ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_release_hook_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_my_word_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_secret ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_secret_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_contract_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 70
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_loyal_mole_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_loyal_mole_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_loyal_mole_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_loyal_mole_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_loyal_mole_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_loyal_mole_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_loyal_mole_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_loyal_mole_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_loyal_mole_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_loyal_mole_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_loyal_mole_agent_tier_value }
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_loyal_mole_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_loyal_mole_ask_value
	add = qpq_loyal_mole_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_opinion_points_value
	add = qpq_loyal_mole_character_value
	add = qpq_loyal_mole_dread_value
	add = qpq_loyal_mole_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_loyal_mole_refusal_value

#### Licensed Feud
qpq_licensed_feud_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}

	value = 3
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }

		add = { value = qpq_licensed_feud_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_licensed_feud_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_licensed_feud_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_licensed_feud_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_licensed_feud_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient }
		}
		add = 15
	}
}
qpq_licensed_feud_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_licensed_feud_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_licensed_feud_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_licensed_feud_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_licensed_feud_ask_value
	add = qpq_licensed_feud_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_opinion_points_value
	add = qpq_licensed_feud_character_value
	add = qpq_licensed_feud_dread_value
	add = qpq_licensed_feud_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_licensed_feud_goal_value
	add = qpq_licensed_feud_refusal_value
}

qpq_licensed_feud_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 18
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 10
	}
	add = {
		value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
		multiply = -0.2
		min = -15
		max = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
		}
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { top_liege = { any_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = { this = scope:secondary_recipient.top_liege } } }
		}
		add = 10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { any_claim = { holder ?= scope:secondary_recipient } } }
		add = 12
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 1.3 } } }
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 1.8 } } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength < { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 0.6 } } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_at_war = yes } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = ambitious } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = brave } }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = wrathful } }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = content } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = craven } }
		add = -10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
		add = -3
	}
}

		max = 15

	if = {

#### Dossier
qpq_dossier_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_dossier_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_dossier_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_dossier_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_dossier_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_dossier_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 50
	}
	add = 10
	multiply = {
		value = 1
		subtract = { value = qpq_dossier_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
		min = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_dossier_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_dossier_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -5
}
qpq_dossier_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_dossier_demand_value
}
qpq_dossier_offer_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes }
			add = qpq_dossier_gold_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }
			add = -3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
			add = -5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_land ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_land_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_office ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_office_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_release_hook ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_release_hook_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_my_word_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_secret ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_secret_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_contract_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 70
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_dossier_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_dossier_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_dossier_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_dossier_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_dossier_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_dossier_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_dossier_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_dossier_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_dossier_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			always = yes
		}
		add = { value = scope:recipient.intrigue multiply = 1 max = 20 }
	}
}
qpq_dossier_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_dossier_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_dossier_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_dossier_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_dossier_ask_value
	add = qpq_dossier_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_opinion_points_value
	add = qpq_dossier_character_value
	add = qpq_dossier_dread_value
	add = qpq_dossier_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_dossier_goal_value
	add = qpq_dossier_refusal_value
}

			add = 1

			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}

qpq_quiet_removal_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_quiet_removal_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 50
	}
	add = 10
	multiply = {
		value = 1
		subtract = { value = qpq_quiet_removal_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
		min = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_quiet_removal_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_quiet_removal_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -25
}
qpq_quiet_removal_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_quiet_removal_demand_value
}
qpq_quiet_removal_offer_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes }
			add = qpq_quiet_removal_gold_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }
			add = -3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
			add = -5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_land ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_land_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_office ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_office_points_value
		}
		if = {

		}

qpq_quiet_removal_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_quiet_removal_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_quiet_removal_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_quiet_removal_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_quiet_removal_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_quiet_removal_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_quiet_removal_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_quiet_removal_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_quiet_removal_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient }
		}
		add = 20
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient }
		}
		add = -40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { OR = { has_trait = sadistic has_trait = callous } }
		}
		add = 10
	}
}
qpq_quiet_removal_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_quiet_removal_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_quiet_removal_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_quiet_removal_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_quiet_removal_ask_value
	add = qpq_quiet_removal_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_opinion_points_value
	add = qpq_quiet_removal_character_value
	add = qpq_quiet_removal_dread_value
	add = qpq_quiet_removal_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_quiet_removal_goal_value
	add = qpq_quiet_removal_refusal_value
}

qpq_quiet_removal_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 18
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 10
	}
	add = {
		value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
		multiply = -0.2
		min = -15
		max = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
		}
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:recipient } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = sadistic } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = vengeful } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = callous } }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = 3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = forgiving } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = -4
	}
}

qpq_quiet_removal_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }

	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 10
	}
	add = {
		value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"

		min = -15
		max = 15

	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25

	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:actor = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
		}
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:actor } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = sadistic } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = vengeful } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = callous } }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = 3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = compassionate } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = forgiving } }
		add = -6

	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = -4
	}
}

#### The Heir Question
qpq_heir_question_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 5
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_heir_question_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 5
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_heir_question_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_heir_question_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_heir_question_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_heir_question_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 50
	}
	add = 10
	multiply = {
		value = 1
		subtract = { value = qpq_heir_question_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
		min = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}

	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = forgiving } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = -4
	}
}

#### Snatch
qpq_snatch_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 4
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_snatch_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 4
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_snatch_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_snatch_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_snatch_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_snatch_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 50
	}
	add = 10
	multiply = {
		value = 1
		subtract = { value = qpq_snatch_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
		min = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_snatch_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_snatch_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -20
}
qpq_snatch_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_snatch_demand_value
}
qpq_snatch_offer_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes }
			add = qpq_snatch_gold_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }
			add = -3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
			add = -5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_land ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_land_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_office ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_office_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_release_hook ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_release_hook_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_my_word_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_secret ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_secret_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_contract_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 70
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_snatch_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_snatch_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_snatch_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_snatch_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_snatch_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_snatch_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_snatch_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_snatch_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_snatch_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_snatch_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_snatch_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_snatch_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_snatch_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_snatch_ask_value
	add = qpq_snatch_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_opinion_points_value
	add = qpq_snatch_character_value
	add = qpq_snatch_dread_value
	add = qpq_snatch_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_snatch_goal_value
	add = qpq_snatch_refusal_value
}

qpq_snatch_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 18
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 10
	}
	add = {
		value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
		multiply = -0.2
		min = -15
		max = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
		}
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:recipient } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = sadistic } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = vengeful } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = callous } }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = 3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = forgiving } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = -4
	}
}

qpq_snatch_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 18
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 10
	}
	add = {
		value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
		multiply = -0.2
		min = -15
		max = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:actor = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
		}
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:actor } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = sadistic } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = vengeful } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = callous } }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = 3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = compassionate } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = forgiving } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = -4
	}
}

	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = forgiving } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = -4
	}
}

qpq_dispossession_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 18
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 10
	}
	add = {
		value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
		multiply = -0.2
		min = -15
		max = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:actor = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
		}
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:actor } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = sadistic } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = vengeful } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = callous } }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = 3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = compassionate } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = forgiving } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = -4
	}
}

#### The Cloister
qpq_the_cloister_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_the_cloister_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_the_cloister_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_the_cloister_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_the_cloister_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_the_cloister_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 50
	}
	add = 10
	multiply = {
		value = 1
		subtract = { value = qpq_the_cloister_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
		min = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_the_cloister_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_the_cloister_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -15
}
qpq_the_cloister_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_the_cloister_demand_value
}
qpq_the_cloister_offer_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes }
			add = qpq_the_cloister_gold_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }
			add = -3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
			add = -5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_land ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_land_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_office ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_office_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_release_hook ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_release_hook_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_my_word_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_secret ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_secret_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_contract_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 70
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_the_cloister_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_the_cloister_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_the_cloister_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_the_cloister_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_the_cloister_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_the_cloister_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_the_cloister_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_the_cloister_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_the_cloister_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:secondary_recipient = scope:recipient
		}
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { has_trait = zealous }
		}
		add = 10
	}
}
qpq_the_cloister_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_the_cloister_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_the_cloister_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_the_cloister_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_the_cloister_ask_value
	add = qpq_the_cloister_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_opinion_points_value
	add = qpq_the_cloister_character_value
	add = qpq_the_cloister_dread_value
	add = qpq_the_cloister_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_the_cloister_goal_value
	add = qpq_the_cloister_refusal_value
}

	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_marriage_by_command_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_marriage_by_command_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_marriage_by_command_agent_tier_value }
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_marriage_by_command_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_marriage_by_command_ask_value
	add = qpq_marriage_by_command_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_opinion_points_value
	add = qpq_marriage_by_command_character_value
	add = qpq_marriage_by_command_dread_value
	add = qpq_marriage_by_command_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_marriage_by_command_refusal_value
}

#### Hand-Over
qpq_hand_over_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:secondary_recipient
			scope:secondary_recipient = {
				OR = {
					is_pool_guest_of = scope:recipient
					is_foreign_court_guest_of = scope:recipient
				}
			}
		}
		add = 1
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_hand_over_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:secondary_recipient
			scope:secondary_recipient = {
				OR = {
					is_close_family_of = scope:recipient
					is_pool_guest_of = scope:recipient
					is_foreign_court_guest_of = scope:recipient
				}
			}
		}
		add = 2
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_hand_over_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_hand_over_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_hand_over_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_hand_over_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 50
	}
	add = 10
	multiply = {
		value = 1
		subtract = { value = qpq_hand_over_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
		min = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_hand_over_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_hand_over_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -5
}
qpq_hand_over_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_hand_over_demand_value
}
qpq_hand_over_offer_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes }
			add = qpq_hand_over_gold_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }
			add = -3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
			add = -5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_land ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_land_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_office ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_office_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_release_hook ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_release_hook_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_my_word_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_secret ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_secret_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_contract_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 70
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_hand_over_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_hand_over_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_hand_over_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_hand_over_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_hand_over_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_hand_over_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_hand_over_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_hand_over_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_hand_over_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_hand_over_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_hand_over_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_hand_over_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_hand_over_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_hand_over_ask_value
	add = qpq_hand_over_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_opinion_points_value
	add = qpq_hand_over_character_value
	add = qpq_hand_over_dread_value
	add = qpq_hand_over_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_hand_over_goal_value
	add = qpq_hand_over_refusal_value
}

qpq_hand_over_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 18
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 10
	}
	add = {
		value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
		multiply = -0.2
		min = -15
		max = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
		}
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:recipient } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = sadistic } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = vengeful } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = callous } }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = 3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = forgiving } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = -4
	}
}

qpq_hand_over_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 18
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 10
	}
	add = {
		value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
		multiply = -0.2
		min = -15
		max = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:actor = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
		}
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:actor } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = sadistic } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = vengeful } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = callous } }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = 3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = compassionate } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = forgiving } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = -4
	}
}

#### Renunciation
qpq_renunciation_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:target.holder }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_renunciation_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:target.holder }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_renunciation_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_renunciation_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_renunciation_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_renunciation_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 50
	}
	add = 10
	multiply = {
		value = 1
		subtract = { value = qpq_renunciation_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
		min = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}

	value = qpq_renunciation_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -5
}

			add = qpq_offer_my_word_points_value
		}

qpq_renunciation_character_value = {
	value = 0

	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_renunciation_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_renunciation_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_renunciation_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_renunciation_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_renunciation_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}

	}

	}

				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_renunciation_agent_tier_value }
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}

qpq_renunciation_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	add = {
		value = 0
		scope:target = {
			if = {
				limit = { tier >= tier_kingdom }
				add = -30
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { tier = tier_duchy }
				add = -18
			}
			else = {
				add = -8
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = ambitious } }
		add = -5
	}
}

		value = 0

			}

				add = -8

		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = greedy } }
		add = -8

	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = ambitious } }

		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes

		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_price_of_loyalty_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 50
	}
	add = 10
	multiply = {
		value = 1
		subtract = { value = qpq_price_of_loyalty_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
		min = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}

	value = qpq_price_of_loyalty_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = 0
}
