	value = 35
	add = { value = qpq_price_of_loyalty_payer_tier_value multiply = -5 }
}
qpq_price_of_loyalty_offer_points_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes }
		add = -30
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
		add = 10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_land ?= yes }
		add = -40
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_office ?= yes }
		add = -15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
		add = -30
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_release_hook ?= yes }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
		add = -12
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_gift_artifact_cost }
			add = { value = scope:qpq_gift_artifact_cost multiply = -1 }
		}
		else = {
			add = -20
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
		add = -15
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes
			scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy }
		}
		add = -10
	}
}

	value = 0

qpq_price_of_loyalty_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 1.2 } } }
		add = 10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { max_military_strength < { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 0.5 } } }
		add = -10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_at_war = yes } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient.culture = scope:actor.culture }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:actor } }
		add = -30
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = trusting } }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = -8
	}
}

qpq_price_of_loyalty_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:actor.max_military_strength multiply = 1.2 } } }
		add = 10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { max_military_strength < { value = scope:actor.max_military_strength multiply = 0.5 } } }
		add = -10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_at_war = yes } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor.culture = scope:recipient.culture }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:recipient } }
		add = -30
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = trusting } }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = -8
	}
}

#### Blessing for a Feud
qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 50
	}
	add = 10
	multiply = {
		value = 1
		subtract = { value = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
		min = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}

qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_ask_value
	add = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_opinion_points_value
	add = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_character_value
	add = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_dread_value
	add = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_goal_value
	add = qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_refusal_value
}

qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 18
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 10
	}
	add = {
		value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
		multiply = -0.2
		min = -15
		max = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
		}
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:recipient } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = sadistic } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = vengeful } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = callous } }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = 3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = forgiving } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = -4
	}
}

qpq_blessing_for_a_feud_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 18
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 10
	}
	add = {
		value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
		multiply = -0.2
		min = -15
		max = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:actor = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
		}
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:actor } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = sadistic } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = vengeful } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = callous } }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = 3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = compassionate } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = forgiving } }
		add = -6

	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = -4
	}
}

#### Electoral Capitulation

	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }

			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}

	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_land ?= yes }
		add = -40
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_office ?= yes }
		add = -15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
		add = -30
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_release_hook ?= yes }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
		add = -12
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_gift_artifact_cost }
			add = { value = scope:qpq_gift_artifact_cost multiply = -1 }
		}
		else = {
			add = -20
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
		add = -15
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes
			scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy }
		}
		add = -10
	}
}
qpq_electoral_capitulation_character_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_electoral_capitulation_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_electoral_capitulation_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_electoral_capitulation_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_electoral_capitulation_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_electoral_capitulation_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_electoral_capitulation_ask_value
	add = qpq_electoral_capitulation_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_opinion_points_value
	add = qpq_electoral_capitulation_character_value
	add = qpq_electoral_capitulation_dread_value
	add = qpq_electoral_capitulation_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_electoral_capitulation_goal_value
	add = qpq_electoral_capitulation_refusal_value
}

qpq_electoral_capitulation_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	add = {
		value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
		multiply = 0.2
		min = -15
		max = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
		}
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 12
	}
}

qpq_electoral_capitulation_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	add = {
		value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
		multiply = 0.2
		min = -15
		max = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
		}
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 12
	}
}

#### Mutual Defense League
qpq_mutual_defense_league_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:actor.liege }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { scope:qpq_x_armed ?= yes } add = 1 }
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_mutual_defense_league_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:actor.liege }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:actor.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { scope:qpq_x_armed ?= yes } add = 1 }
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_mutual_defense_league_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_mutual_defense_league_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_mutual_defense_league_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_mutual_defense_league_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 50
	}
	add = 10
	multiply = {
		value = 1
		subtract = { value = qpq_mutual_defense_league_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
		min = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_mutual_defense_league_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_mutual_defense_league_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -10
}
qpq_mutual_defense_league_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_mutual_defense_league_demand_value
}
qpq_mutual_defense_league_offer_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes }
			add = qpq_mutual_defense_league_gold_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }
			add = -3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
			add = -5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_land ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_land_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_office ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_office_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_release_hook ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_release_hook_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_my_word_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_secret ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_secret_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_contract_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 70
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_mutual_defense_league_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_mutual_defense_league_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_mutual_defense_league_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_mutual_defense_league_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_mutual_defense_league_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_mutual_defense_league_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_mutual_defense_league_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_mutual_defense_league_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_mutual_defense_league_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { opinion = { target = scope:actor.liege value <= -20 } }
		}
		add = 15
	}
}
qpq_mutual_defense_league_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_mutual_defense_league_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_mutual_defense_league_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_mutual_defense_league_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_mutual_defense_league_ask_value
	add = qpq_mutual_defense_league_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_opinion_points_value
	add = qpq_mutual_defense_league_character_value
	add = qpq_mutual_defense_league_dread_value
	add = qpq_mutual_defense_league_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_mutual_defense_league_goal_value
	add = qpq_mutual_defense_league_refusal_value
}

qpq_mutual_defense_league_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 1.2 } } }
		add = 10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { max_military_strength < { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 0.5 } } }
		add = -10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_at_war = yes } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient.culture = scope:actor.culture }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:actor } }
		add = -30
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = trusting } }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = -8
	}
}

qpq_mutual_defense_league_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:actor.max_military_strength multiply = 1.2 } } }
		add = 10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { max_military_strength < { value = scope:actor.max_military_strength multiply = 0.5 } } }
		add = -10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_at_war = yes } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor.culture = scope:recipient.culture }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:recipient } }
		add = -30
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = trusting } }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = -8
	}
}

}
qpq_faction_pledge_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_faction_pledge_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_faction_pledge_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_faction_pledge_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_faction_pledge_ask_value
	add = qpq_faction_pledge_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_opinion_points_value
	add = qpq_faction_pledge_character_value
	add = qpq_faction_pledge_dread_value
	add = qpq_faction_pledge_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_faction_pledge_goal_value
	add = qpq_faction_pledge_refusal_value
}

qpq_faction_pledge_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 1.2 } } }
		add = 10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { max_military_strength < { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 0.5 } } }
		add = -10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_at_war = yes } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient.culture = scope:actor.culture }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:actor } }
		add = -30
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = trusting } }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = -8
	}
}

qpq_faction_pledge_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:actor.max_military_strength multiply = 1.2 } } }
		add = 10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { max_military_strength < { value = scope:actor.max_military_strength multiply = 0.5 } } }
		add = -10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_at_war = yes } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor.culture = scope:recipient.culture }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:recipient } }
		add = -30
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = trusting } }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = -8
	}
}

#### Title Swap
qpq_title_swap_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:target.holder }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { scope:qpq_x_consent ?= yes } add = -2 }
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_title_swap_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:target.holder }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { scope:qpq_x_consent ?= yes } add = -2 }
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_title_swap_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_title_swap_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_title_swap_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_title_swap_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 50
	}
	add = 10
	multiply = {
		value = 1
		subtract = { value = qpq_title_swap_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
		min = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_title_swap_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_title_swap_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -10
}
qpq_title_swap_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_title_swap_demand_value
}
qpq_title_swap_offer_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes }
			add = qpq_title_swap_gold_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }
			add = -3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
			add = -5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_land ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_land_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_office ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_office_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_release_hook ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_release_hook_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_my_word_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_secret ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_secret_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_contract_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 70
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_title_swap_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_title_swap_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_title_swap_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_title_swap_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_title_swap_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_title_swap_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_title_swap_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_title_swap_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_title_swap_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_title_swap_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_title_swap_agent_tier_value }
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_title_swap_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_title_swap_ask_value
	add = qpq_title_swap_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_opinion_points_value
	add = qpq_title_swap_character_value
	add = qpq_title_swap_dread_value
	add = qpq_title_swap_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_title_swap_goal_value
	add = qpq_title_swap_refusal_value
}

qpq_title_swap_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	add = {
		value = 0
		scope:target = {
			if = {
				limit = { tier >= tier_kingdom }
				add = -30
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { tier = tier_duchy }
				add = -18
			}
			else = {
				add = -8
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = ambitious } }
		add = -5
	}
}

qpq_title_swap_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	add = {
		value = 0
		scope:target = {
			if = {
				limit = { tier >= tier_kingdom }
				add = -30
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { tier = tier_duchy }
				add = -18
			}
			else = {
				add = -8
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = generous } }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = greedy } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = ambitious } }
		add = -5
	}
}

}

qpq_coup_pact_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:actor.liege } }
		add = 18
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:actor.liege } }
		add = 10
	}
	add = {
		value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:actor.liege)"
		multiply = -0.2
		min = -15
		max = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:actor.liege } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:actor.liege } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:actor.liege }
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:actor.liege }
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:actor.liege }
			}
		}
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:actor.liege } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor.liege = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:recipient } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = sadistic } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = vengeful } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = callous } }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = 3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = forgiving } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = -4
	}
}

qpq_coup_pact_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:recipient.liege } }
		add = 18
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:recipient.liege } }
		add = 10
	}
	add = {
		value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:recipient.liege)"
		multiply = -0.2
		min = -15
		max = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:recipient.liege } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:recipient.liege } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:recipient.liege }
				scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:recipient.liege }
				scope:actor = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:recipient.liege }
			}
		}
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:recipient.liege } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient.liege = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:actor } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = sadistic } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = vengeful } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = callous } }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = 3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = compassionate } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = forgiving } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = -4
	}
}

#### Proxy War
qpq_proxy_war_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_proxy_war_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_proxy_war_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_proxy_war_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_proxy_war_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_proxy_war_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 50
	}
	add = 10
	multiply = {
		value = 1
		subtract = { value = qpq_proxy_war_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
		min = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_proxy_war_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_proxy_war_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -20
}
qpq_proxy_war_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_proxy_war_demand_value
}
qpq_proxy_war_offer_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes }
			add = qpq_proxy_war_gold_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }
			add = -3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
			add = -5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_land ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_land_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_claim ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_claim_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_office ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_office_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_release_hook ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_release_hook_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_my_word_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_secret ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_secret_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_contract_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 70
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_proxy_war_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_proxy_war_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_proxy_war_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_proxy_war_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_proxy_war_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_proxy_war_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_proxy_war_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_proxy_war_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_proxy_war_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient }
		}
		add = 10
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient }
		}
		add = -20
	}
}
qpq_proxy_war_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_proxy_war_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_proxy_war_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_proxy_war_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_proxy_war_ask_value
	add = qpq_proxy_war_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_opinion_points_value
	add = qpq_proxy_war_character_value
	add = qpq_proxy_war_dread_value
	add = qpq_proxy_war_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_proxy_war_goal_value
	add = qpq_proxy_war_refusal_value
}

qpq_proxy_war_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 18
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 10
	}
	add = {
		value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
		multiply = -0.2
		min = -15
		max = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
		}
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { top_liege = { any_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = { this = scope:secondary_recipient.top_liege } } }
		}
		add = 10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { any_claim = { holder ?= scope:secondary_recipient } } }
		add = 12
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 1.3 } } }
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 1.8 } } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength < { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 0.6 } } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_at_war = yes } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = ambitious } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = brave } }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = wrathful } }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = content } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = craven } }
		add = -10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
		add = -3
	}
}

#### Partition Pact
qpq_partition_pact_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}

	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_partition_pact_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_partition_pact_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_partition_pact_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_partition_pact_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_partition_pact_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_partition_pact_ask_value
	add = qpq_partition_pact_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_opinion_points_value
	add = qpq_partition_pact_character_value
	add = qpq_partition_pact_dread_value
	add = qpq_partition_pact_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_partition_pact_goal_value
	add = qpq_partition_pact_refusal_value
}

qpq_partition_pact_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 18
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 10
	}
	add = {
		value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
		multiply = -0.2
		min = -15
		max = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
		}
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { top_liege = { any_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = { this = scope:secondary_recipient.top_liege } } }
		}
		add = 10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { any_claim = { holder ?= scope:secondary_recipient } } }
		add = 12
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 1.3 } } }
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 1.8 } } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength < { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 0.6 } } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_at_war = yes } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = ambitious } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = brave } }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = wrathful } }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = content } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = craven } }
		add = -10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
		add = -3
	}
}

qpq_partition_pact_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 18
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 10
	}
	add = {
		value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
		multiply = -0.2
		min = -15
		max = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:actor = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
		}
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:actor = { top_liege = { any_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = { this = scope:secondary_recipient.top_liege } } }
		}
		add = 10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { any_claim = { holder ?= scope:secondary_recipient } } }
		add = 12
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:actor.max_military_strength multiply = 1.3 } } }
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:actor.max_military_strength multiply = 1.8 } } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength < { value = scope:actor.max_military_strength multiply = 0.6 } } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_at_war = yes } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = ambitious } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = brave } }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = wrathful } }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = content } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = craven } }
		add = -10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = compassionate } }
		add = -3
	}
}

#### Secret Alliance
qpq_secret_alliance_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	if = { limit = { scope:actor = { is_independent_ruler = no } } add = 3 }
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_secret_alliance_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	if = { limit = { scope:recipient = { is_independent_ruler = no } } add = 3 }
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_secret_alliance_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_secret_alliance_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_secret_alliance_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_secret_alliance_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 50
	}
	add = 10
	multiply = {
		value = 1
		subtract = { value = qpq_secret_alliance_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
		min = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_secret_alliance_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_secret_alliance_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -10
}
qpq_secret_alliance_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_secret_alliance_demand_value
}
qpq_secret_alliance_offer_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes }
			add = qpq_secret_alliance_gold_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }
			add = -3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
			add = -5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_land ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_land_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_office ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_office_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_release_hook ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_release_hook_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_my_word_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_secret ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_secret_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_contract_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 70
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_secret_alliance_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_secret_alliance_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_secret_alliance_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_secret_alliance_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_secret_alliance_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_secret_alliance_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_secret_alliance_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_secret_alliance_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}

				qpq_secret_alliance_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}

	value = qpq_secret_alliance_ask_value
	add = qpq_secret_alliance_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_opinion_points_value
	add = qpq_secret_alliance_character_value

	add = qpq_secret_alliance_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_secret_alliance_goal_value
	add = qpq_secret_alliance_refusal_value

qpq_secret_alliance_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 1.2 } } }
		add = 10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { max_military_strength < { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 0.5 } } }
		add = -10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_at_war = yes } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient.culture = scope:actor.culture }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:actor } }
		add = -30
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = trusting } }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = -8
	}
}

qpq_secret_alliance_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:actor.max_military_strength multiply = 1.2 } } }
		add = 10
	}

#### Bought Truce
qpq_bought_truce_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	if = { limit = { scope:actor = { is_at_war_with = scope:recipient } } add = 1 }
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_bought_truce_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	if = { limit = { scope:recipient = { qpq_is_head_of_faith_trigger = yes } } add = 3 }
	else_if = { limit = { scope:recipient = { is_clergy = yes } } add = 1 }
	if = { limit = { scope:recipient = { is_in_ongoing_great_holy_war = yes } } add = 1 }
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_bought_truce_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_bought_truce_agent_tier_value

	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { max_military_strength < { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 0.5 } } }
		add = -10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_at_war = yes } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient.culture = scope:actor.culture }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:actor } }
		add = -30
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = trusting } }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = -8
	}
}

qpq_bought_truce_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:actor.max_military_strength multiply = 1.2 } } }
		add = 10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { max_military_strength < { value = scope:actor.max_military_strength multiply = 0.5 } } }
		add = -10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_at_war = yes } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor.culture = scope:recipient.culture }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:recipient } }
		add = -30
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = trusting } }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = -8
	}
}

#### Faithless Ally
qpq_faithless_ally_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_faithless_ally_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_faithless_ally_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_faithless_ally_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_faithless_ally_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_faithless_ally_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 50
	}
	add = 10
	multiply = {
		value = 1
		subtract = { value = qpq_faithless_ally_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
		min = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_faithless_ally_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_faithless_ally_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -10
}
qpq_faithless_ally_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_faithless_ally_demand_value
}
qpq_faithless_ally_offer_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes }
			add = qpq_faithless_ally_gold_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }
			add = -3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
			add = -5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_land ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_land_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_office ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_office_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_release_hook ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_release_hook_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_my_word_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_secret ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_secret_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_contract_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 70
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_faithless_ally_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_faithless_ally_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_faithless_ally_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_faithless_ally_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_faithless_ally_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_faithless_ally_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_faithless_ally_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_faithless_ally_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_faithless_ally_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { opinion = { target = scope:secondary_recipient value >= 50 } }
		}
		add = -15
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest }
		}
		add = -10
	}
}
qpq_faithless_ally_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_faithless_ally_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_faithless_ally_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_faithless_ally_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_faithless_ally_ask_value
	add = qpq_faithless_ally_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_opinion_points_value
	add = qpq_faithless_ally_character_value
	add = qpq_faithless_ally_dread_value
	add = qpq_faithless_ally_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_faithless_ally_goal_value
	add = qpq_faithless_ally_refusal_value
}

qpq_faithless_ally_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 18
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 10
	}
	add = {
		value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
		multiply = -0.2
		min = -15
		max = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
		}
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:recipient } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = sadistic } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = vengeful } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = callous } }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = 3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = forgiving } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = -4
	}
}

	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = forgiving } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = -4
	}
}

qpq_turncoat_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:actor.liege } }
		add = 18
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:actor.liege } }
		add = 10
	}
	add = {
		value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:actor.liege)"
		multiply = -0.2
		min = -15
		max = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:actor.liege } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:actor.liege } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:actor.liege }
				scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:actor.liege }
				scope:actor = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:actor.liege }
			}
		}
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:actor.liege } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor.liege = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:actor } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = sadistic } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = vengeful } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = callous } }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = 3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = compassionate } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = forgiving } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = -4
	}
}

#### Seed the Separatists
qpq_seed_the_separatists_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:recipient.liege }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient.liege.faith = scope:actor.faith
			NOT = { scope:actor = { is_at_war_with = scope:recipient.liege } }
		}
		add = 1
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_seed_the_separatists_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 4
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_seed_the_separatists_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_seed_the_separatists_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_seed_the_separatists_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_seed_the_separatists_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 50
	}
	add = 10
	multiply = {
		value = 1
		subtract = { value = qpq_seed_the_separatists_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
		min = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_seed_the_separatists_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_seed_the_separatists_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -25
}
qpq_seed_the_separatists_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_seed_the_separatists_demand_value
}
qpq_seed_the_separatists_offer_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes }
			add = qpq_seed_the_separatists_gold_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }
			add = -3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
			add = -5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_land ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_land_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_office ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_office_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_release_hook ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_release_hook_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_my_word_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_secret ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_secret_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_contract_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 70
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_seed_the_separatists_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_seed_the_separatists_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_seed_the_separatists_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_seed_the_separatists_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_seed_the_separatists_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_seed_the_separatists_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_seed_the_separatists_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_seed_the_separatists_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_seed_the_separatists_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { opinion = { target = scope:recipient.liege value <= -20 } }
		}
		add = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { has_trait = ambitious }
		}
		add = 10
	}
}
qpq_seed_the_separatists_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_seed_the_separatists_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_seed_the_separatists_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_seed_the_separatists_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_seed_the_separatists_ask_value
	add = qpq_seed_the_separatists_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_opinion_points_value
	add = qpq_seed_the_separatists_character_value
	add = qpq_seed_the_separatists_dread_value
	add = qpq_seed_the_separatists_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_seed_the_separatists_goal_value
	add = qpq_seed_the_separatists_refusal_value
}

qpq_seed_the_separatists_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 1.2 } } }
		add = 10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { max_military_strength < { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 0.5 } } }
		add = -10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_at_war = yes } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient.culture = scope:actor.culture }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:actor } }
		add = -30
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = trusting } }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = -8
	}
}

qpq_seed_the_separatists_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0

	}

#### Shelter the Pretender
qpq_shelter_the_pretender_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:target.holder }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { scope:qpq_x_armies ?= yes } add = 1 }
	min = 0
	max = 5
}

	max = 5
