#### Extradition
qpq_extradition_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			exists = scope:secondary_recipient
			scope:secondary_recipient = { any_claim = { holder ?= scope:actor } }
		}
		add = 1
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_extradition_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_extradition_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_extradition_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_extradition_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_extradition_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 50
	}
	add = 10
	multiply = {
		value = 1
		subtract = { value = qpq_extradition_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
		min = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_extradition_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_extradition_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -15
}
qpq_extradition_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_extradition_demand_value
}
qpq_extradition_offer_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes }
			add = qpq_extradition_gold_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }
			add = -3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
			add = -5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_land ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_land_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_office ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_office_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_release_hook ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_release_hook_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_my_word_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_secret ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_secret_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_contract_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 70
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_extradition_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_extradition_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_extradition_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_extradition_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_extradition_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_extradition_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_extradition_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_extradition_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_extradition_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_extradition_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_extradition_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_extradition_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_extradition_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_extradition_ask_value
	add = qpq_extradition_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_opinion_points_value
	add = qpq_extradition_character_value
	add = qpq_extradition_dread_value
	add = qpq_extradition_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_extradition_goal_value
	add = qpq_extradition_refusal_value
}

qpq_extradition_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 18
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 10
	}
	add = {
		value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
		multiply = -0.2
		min = -15
		max = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
		}
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:recipient } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = sadistic } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = vengeful } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = callous } }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = 3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = forgiving } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = -4
	}
}

qpq_extradition_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 18
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 10
	}
	add = {
		value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
		multiply = -0.2
		min = -15
		max = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:actor = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
		}
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:actor } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = sadistic } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = vengeful } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = callous } }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = 3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = compassionate } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = forgiving } }
		add = -6

	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = -4
	}
}

#### Buy a Councillor
qpq_buy_a_councillor_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:recipient.liege }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_buy_a_councillor_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 4
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_buy_a_councillor_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_buy_a_councillor_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_buy_a_councillor_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_buy_a_councillor_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 50
	}
	add = 10
	multiply = {
		value = 1
		subtract = { value = qpq_buy_a_councillor_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
		min = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_buy_a_councillor_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_buy_a_councillor_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -15
}
qpq_buy_a_councillor_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_buy_a_councillor_demand_value
}

		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_secret ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_secret_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_contract_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value

			limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }

		}

	}

#### Stay Home
qpq_stay_home_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:recipient.liege }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_stay_home_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_stay_home_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_stay_home_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_stay_home_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_stay_home_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 50
	}
	add = 10
	multiply = {
		value = 1
		subtract = { value = qpq_stay_home_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
		min = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_stay_home_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_stay_home_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -10
}
qpq_stay_home_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_stay_home_demand_value
}
qpq_stay_home_offer_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes }
			add = qpq_stay_home_gold_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }
			add = -3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
			add = -5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_land ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_land_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_office ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_office_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_release_hook ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_release_hook_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_my_word_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_secret ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_secret_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_contract_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 70
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_stay_home_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_stay_home_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_stay_home_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_stay_home_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_stay_home_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_stay_home_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_stay_home_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_stay_home_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_stay_home_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_stay_home_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_stay_home_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_stay_home_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_stay_home_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_stay_home_ask_value
	add = qpq_stay_home_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_opinion_points_value
	add = qpq_stay_home_character_value
	add = qpq_stay_home_dread_value
	add = qpq_stay_home_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_stay_home_goal_value
	add = qpq_stay_home_refusal_value
}

qpq_stay_home_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 1.2 } } }
		add = 10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { max_military_strength < { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 0.5 } } }
		add = -10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_at_war = yes } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient.culture = scope:actor.culture }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:actor } }
		add = -30
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = trusting } }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = -8
	}
}

qpq_stay_home_goal_sw_value = {

#### Defection Pact
qpq_defection_pact_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:recipient.liege }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_defection_pact_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 4
	min = 0
	max = 5
}

		value = qpq_defection_pact_agent_tier_value

#### Secret Clause
qpq_secret_clause_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:target.holder }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:target.holder } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}

		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_secret_clause_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_secret_clause_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_secret_clause_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_secret_clause_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_secret_clause_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_secret_clause_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_secret_clause_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_secret_clause_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_secret_clause_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_secret_clause_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_secret_clause_agent_tier_value }
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_secret_clause_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_secret_clause_ask_value
	add = qpq_secret_clause_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_opinion_points_value
	add = qpq_secret_clause_character_value
	add = qpq_secret_clause_dread_value
	add = qpq_secret_clause_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_secret_clause_goal_value
	add = qpq_secret_clause_refusal_value
}

qpq_secret_clause_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	add = {
		value = 0
		scope:target = {
			if = {
				limit = { tier >= tier_kingdom }
				add = -30
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { tier = tier_duchy }
				add = -18
			}
			else = {
				add = -8
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = ambitious } }
		add = -5
	}
}

qpq_secret_clause_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	add = {
		value = 0
		scope:target = {
			if = {
				limit = { tier >= tier_kingdom }
				add = -30
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { tier = tier_duchy }
				add = -18
			}
			else = {
				add = -8
			}
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = generous } }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = greedy } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = ambitious } }
		add = -5
	}
}

#### Hire the Hashashin
qpq_hire_the_hashashin_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 5
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_hire_the_hashashin_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 5
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_hire_the_hashashin_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_hire_the_hashashin_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_hire_the_hashashin_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_hire_the_hashashin_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 50
	}
	add = 10
	multiply = {
		value = 1
		subtract = { value = qpq_hire_the_hashashin_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
		min = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_hire_the_hashashin_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_hire_the_hashashin_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -20
}
qpq_hire_the_hashashin_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_hire_the_hashashin_demand_value
}
qpq_hire_the_hashashin_offer_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes }
			add = qpq_hire_the_hashashin_gold_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }
			add = -3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
			add = -5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_land ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_land_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_office ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_office_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_release_hook ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_release_hook_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_my_word_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_secret ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_secret_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_contract_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 70
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}

		add = { value = qpq_hire_the_hashashin_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_hire_the_hashashin_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }

	value = 0
}
qpq_hire_the_hashashin_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_hire_the_hashashin_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_hire_the_hashashin_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_hire_the_hashashin_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_hire_the_hashashin_ask_value
	add = qpq_hire_the_hashashin_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_opinion_points_value
	add = qpq_hire_the_hashashin_character_value
	add = qpq_hire_the_hashashin_dread_value
	add = qpq_hire_the_hashashin_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_hire_the_hashashin_goal_value
	add = qpq_hire_the_hashashin_refusal_value
}

qpq_hire_the_hashashin_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 18
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 10
	}
	add = {
		value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
		multiply = -0.2
		min = -15
		max = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
		}
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:recipient } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = sadistic } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = vengeful } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = callous } }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = 3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = forgiving } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = -4
	}
}

qpq_hire_the_hashashin_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 18
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 10
	}
	add = {
		value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
		multiply = -0.2
		min = -15
		max = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:actor = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
		}
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:actor } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = sadistic } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = vengeful } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = callous } }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = 3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = compassionate } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = forgiving } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = -4
	}
}

			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_excommunication_for_hire_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_excommunication_for_hire_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_ask_value
	add = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_opinion_points_value
	add = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_character_value
	add = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_dread_value
	add = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_goal_value
	add = qpq_excommunication_for_hire_refusal_value
}

qpq_excommunication_for_hire_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 18
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 10
	}
	add = {
		value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
		multiply = -0.2
		min = -15
		max = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
		}
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:recipient } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = sadistic } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = vengeful } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = callous } }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = 3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = forgiving } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = -4
	}
}

qpq_excommunication_for_hire_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 18
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 10
	}
	add = {
		value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
		multiply = -0.2
		min = -15
		max = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:actor = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
		}
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:actor } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = sadistic } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = vengeful } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = callous } }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = 3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = compassionate } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = forgiving } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = -4
	}
}

#### Dispensation for Gold
qpq_dispensation_for_gold_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_dispensation_for_gold_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_dispensation_for_gold_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_dispensation_for_gold_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_dispensation_for_gold_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_dispensation_for_gold_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 50
	}
	add = 10
	multiply = {
		value = 1
		subtract = { value = qpq_dispensation_for_gold_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
		min = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_dispensation_for_gold_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_dispensation_for_gold_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -5
}
qpq_dispensation_for_gold_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_dispensation_for_gold_demand_value
}
qpq_dispensation_for_gold_offer_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes }
			add = qpq_dispensation_for_gold_gold_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }
			add = -3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
			add = -5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_land ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_land_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_office ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_office_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_release_hook ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_release_hook_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_my_word_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_secret ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_secret_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_contract_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 70
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_dispensation_for_gold_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_dispensation_for_gold_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_dispensation_for_gold_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_dispensation_for_gold_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_dispensation_for_gold_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_dispensation_for_gold_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_dispensation_for_gold_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_dispensation_for_gold_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_dispensation_for_gold_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_dispensation_for_gold_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_dispensation_for_gold_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_dispensation_for_gold_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}

	value = qpq_dispensation_for_gold_ask_value
	add = qpq_dispensation_for_gold_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_opinion_points_value
	add = qpq_dispensation_for_gold_character_value

	add = qpq_dispensation_for_gold_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_dispensation_for_gold_goal_value
	add = qpq_dispensation_for_gold_refusal_value
}

				scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
		}
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { top_liege = { any_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = { this = scope:secondary_recipient.top_liege } } }
		}
		add = 10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { any_claim = { holder ?= scope:secondary_recipient } } }
		add = 12
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 1.3 } } }
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 1.8 } } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength < { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 0.6 } } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_at_war = yes } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = ambitious } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = brave } }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = wrathful } }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = content } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = craven } }
		add = -10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
		add = -3
	}
}

qpq_steer_the_holy_war_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 18
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 10
	}
	add = {
		value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
		multiply = -0.2
		min = -15
		max = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:actor = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
		}
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:actor = { top_liege = { any_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = { this = scope:secondary_recipient.top_liege } } }
		}
		add = 10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { any_claim = { holder ?= scope:secondary_recipient } } }
		add = 12
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:actor.max_military_strength multiply = 1.3 } } }
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:actor.max_military_strength multiply = 1.8 } } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength < { value = scope:actor.max_military_strength multiply = 0.6 } } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_at_war = yes } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = ambitious } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = brave } }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = wrathful } }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = content } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = craven } }
		add = -10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = compassionate } }
		add = -3
	}
}

#### Purchase a Mitre
qpq_purchase_a_mitre_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	if = { limit = { scope:recipient.faith = { has_doctrine_parameter = has_clerical_electors } } add = 1 }
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_purchase_a_mitre_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	if = { limit = { scope:recipient.faith = { has_doctrine_parameter = has_clerical_electors } } add = 1 }
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_purchase_a_mitre_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_purchase_a_mitre_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_purchase_a_mitre_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_purchase_a_mitre_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 50
	}
	add = 10
	multiply = {
		value = 1
		subtract = { value = qpq_purchase_a_mitre_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
		min = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_purchase_a_mitre_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_purchase_a_mitre_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -10
}
qpq_purchase_a_mitre_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_purchase_a_mitre_demand_value
}
qpq_purchase_a_mitre_offer_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes }
			add = qpq_purchase_a_mitre_gold_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }
			add = -3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
			add = -5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_land ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_land_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_office ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_office_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_release_hook ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_release_hook_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_my_word_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_secret ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_secret_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_contract_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 70
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_purchase_a_mitre_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_purchase_a_mitre_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_purchase_a_mitre_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_purchase_a_mitre_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_purchase_a_mitre_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_purchase_a_mitre_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_purchase_a_mitre_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_purchase_a_mitre_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_purchase_a_mitre_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_purchase_a_mitre_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_purchase_a_mitre_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_purchase_a_mitre_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_purchase_a_mitre_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_purchase_a_mitre_ask_value
	add = qpq_purchase_a_mitre_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_opinion_points_value
	add = qpq_purchase_a_mitre_character_value
	add = qpq_purchase_a_mitre_dread_value
	add = qpq_purchase_a_mitre_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_purchase_a_mitre_goal_value
	add = qpq_purchase_a_mitre_refusal_value
}

		add = 10

	}

			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {

			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}

		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:recipient } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = sadistic } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = vengeful } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = callous } }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = 3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = forgiving } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = -4
	}
}

		add = 10

		multiply = -0.2
		min = -15
		max = 15

		add = -25

				scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }

		add = -20

		add = 6
	}

#### Absolution by Concession
qpq_absolution_by_concession_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_absolution_by_concession_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_absolution_by_concession_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_absolution_by_concession_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_absolution_by_concession_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_absolution_by_concession_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 50
	}
	add = 10
	multiply = {
		value = 1
		subtract = { value = qpq_absolution_by_concession_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
		min = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_absolution_by_concession_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_absolution_by_concession_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = 0
}
qpq_absolution_by_concession_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_absolution_by_concession_demand_value
}
qpq_absolution_by_concession_offer_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes }
			add = qpq_absolution_by_concession_gold_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }
			add = -3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
			add = -5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_land ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_land_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_office ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_office_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_release_hook ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_release_hook_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_my_word_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_secret ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_secret_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_contract_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 70
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_absolution_by_concession_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_absolution_by_concession_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_absolution_by_concession_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_absolution_by_concession_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_absolution_by_concession_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_absolution_by_concession_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_absolution_by_concession_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}

	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}

	value = 0
}
qpq_absolution_by_concession_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_absolution_by_concession_agent_tier_value }
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_absolution_by_concession_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_absolution_by_concession_ask_value
	add = qpq_absolution_by_concession_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_opinion_points_value
	add = qpq_absolution_by_concession_character_value
	add = qpq_absolution_by_concession_dread_value
	add = qpq_absolution_by_concession_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_absolution_by_concession_goal_value
	add = qpq_absolution_by_concession_refusal_value
}

qpq_absolution_by_concession_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith } }
		add = -12
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = excommunicated } }
		add = -15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { piety_level >= 3 } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = zealous } }
		add = 4
	}
}

#### Holy Warrant
qpq_holy_warrant_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 3
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}

qpq_holy_warrant_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 18
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 10
	}
	add = {
		value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
		multiply = -0.2
		min = -15
		max = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
		}
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { top_liege = { any_neighboring_and_across_water_top_liege_realm_owner = { this = scope:secondary_recipient.top_liege } } }
		}
		add = 10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { any_claim = { holder ?= scope:secondary_recipient } } }
		add = 12
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 1.3 } } }
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 1.8 } } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength < { value = scope:recipient.max_military_strength multiply = 0.6 } } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_at_war = yes } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = ambitious } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = brave } }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = wrathful } }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = content } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = craven } }
		add = -10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
		add = -3
	}
}

	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:actor.max_military_strength multiply = 1.3 } } }
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength > { value = scope:actor.max_military_strength multiply = 1.8 } } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { max_military_strength < { value = scope:actor.max_military_strength multiply = 0.6 } } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_at_war = yes } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = ambitious } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = brave } }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = wrathful } }
		add = 4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = content } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = craven } }
		add = -10
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = compassionate } }
		add = -3
	}
}

#### Buy a Bull
qpq_buy_a_bull_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 4
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_buy_a_bull_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 4
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_buy_a_bull_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_buy_a_bull_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_buy_a_bull_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_buy_a_bull_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 50
	}
	add = 10
	multiply = {
		value = 1
		subtract = { value = qpq_buy_a_bull_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
		min = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_buy_a_bull_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_buy_a_bull_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -10
}
qpq_buy_a_bull_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_buy_a_bull_demand_value
}
qpq_buy_a_bull_offer_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes }
			add = qpq_buy_a_bull_gold_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }
			add = -3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
			add = -5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_land ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_land_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_office ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_office_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_release_hook ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_release_hook_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_my_word_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_secret ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_secret_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_contract_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 70
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_buy_a_bull_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_buy_a_bull_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_buy_a_bull_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_buy_a_bull_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_buy_a_bull_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_buy_a_bull_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_buy_a_bull_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_buy_a_bull_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_buy_a_bull_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_buy_a_bull_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_buy_a_bull_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_buy_a_bull_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_buy_a_bull_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_buy_a_bull_ask_value
	add = qpq_buy_a_bull_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_opinion_points_value
	add = qpq_buy_a_bull_character_value
	add = qpq_buy_a_bull_dread_value
	add = qpq_buy_a_bull_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_buy_a_bull_goal_value
	add = qpq_buy_a_bull_refusal_value
}

qpq_buy_a_bull_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 18
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 10
	}
	add = {
		value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
		multiply = -0.2
		min = -15
		max = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
		}
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:recipient } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = sadistic } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = vengeful } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = callous } }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = 3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = forgiving } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = -4
	}
}

qpq_buy_a_bull_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 18
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 10
	}
	add = {
		value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
		multiply = -0.2
		min = -15
		max = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:actor = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
		}
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:actor } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = sadistic } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = vengeful } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = callous } }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = 3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = compassionate } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = forgiving } }
		add = -6

	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = -4

}

#### Council Lobbying
qpq_council_lobbying_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_council_lobbying_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_council_lobbying_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_council_lobbying_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_council_lobbying_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_council_lobbying_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 50
	}
	add = 10
	multiply = {
		value = 1
		subtract = { value = qpq_council_lobbying_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
		min = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_council_lobbying_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_council_lobbying_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = 0
}
qpq_council_lobbying_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_council_lobbying_demand_value
}
qpq_council_lobbying_offer_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes }
			add = qpq_council_lobbying_gold_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }
			add = -3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
			add = -5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_land ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_land_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_office ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_office_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_release_hook ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_release_hook_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_my_word_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_secret ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_secret_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_contract_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 70
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_council_lobbying_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_council_lobbying_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_council_lobbying_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_council_lobbying_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_council_lobbying_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_council_lobbying_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_council_lobbying_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_council_lobbying_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_council_lobbying_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_council_lobbying_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_council_lobbying_agent_tier_value }
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_council_lobbying_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_council_lobbying_ask_value
	add = qpq_council_lobbying_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_opinion_points_value
	add = qpq_council_lobbying_character_value
	add = qpq_council_lobbying_dread_value
	add = qpq_council_lobbying_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_council_lobbying_goal_value
	add = qpq_council_lobbying_refusal_value
}

qpq_council_lobbying_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith } }
		add = -12
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = excommunicated } }
		add = -15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { piety_level >= 3 } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = zealous } }
		add = 4
	}
}

qpq_council_lobbying_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith } }
		add = -12
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = excommunicated } }
		add = -15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { piety_level >= 3 } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = zealous } }
		add = 4
	}
}

#### Caliphal Investiture
qpq_caliphal_investiture_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_caliphal_investiture_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_caliphal_investiture_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_caliphal_investiture_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_caliphal_investiture_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_caliphal_investiture_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 50
	}
	add = 10
	multiply = {
		value = 1
		subtract = { value = qpq_caliphal_investiture_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
		min = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}

#### Name in the Khutba
qpq_name_in_the_khutba_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:recipient.liege }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:recipient.liege } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_name_in_the_khutba_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 4
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_name_in_the_khutba_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_name_in_the_khutba_agent_tier_value
