	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith } }
		add = -12
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = excommunicated } }
		add = -15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { piety_level >= 3 } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = zealous } }
		add = 4
	}
}

qpq_name_in_the_khutba_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith } }
		add = -12
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = excommunicated } }
		add = -15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { piety_level >= 3 } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = zealous } }
		add = 4
	}
}

#### Fatwa for Hire
qpq_fatwa_for_hire_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_fatwa_for_hire_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	if = { limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient scope:secondary_recipient = { highest_held_title_tier >= tier_kingdom } } add = 1 }
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_fatwa_for_hire_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_fatwa_for_hire_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 50
	}
	add = 10
	multiply = {
		value = 1
		subtract = { value = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
		min = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_fatwa_for_hire_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -10
}
qpq_fatwa_for_hire_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_demand_value
}
qpq_fatwa_for_hire_offer_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes }
			add = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_gold_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }
			add = -3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
			add = -5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_land ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_land_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_office ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_office_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_release_hook ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_release_hook_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_my_word_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_secret ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_secret_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_contract_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 70
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_fatwa_for_hire_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_fatwa_for_hire_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_fatwa_for_hire_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_fatwa_for_hire_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_fatwa_for_hire_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_fatwa_for_hire_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_ask_value
	add = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_opinion_points_value
	add = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_character_value
	add = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_dread_value
	add = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_goal_value
	add = qpq_fatwa_for_hire_refusal_value
}

qpq_fatwa_for_hire_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 18
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 10
	}
	add = {
		value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
		multiply = -0.2
		min = -15
		max = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
		}
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:recipient } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = sadistic } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = vengeful } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = callous } }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = 3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = forgiving } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = -4
	}
}

qpq_fatwa_for_hire_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 18
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 10
	}
	add = {
		value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
		multiply = -0.2
		min = -15
		max = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25

		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:actor = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }

		}
		add = -20
	}

		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:actor } }

}

	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { scope:recipient.faith = scope:actor.faith } }
		add = -12
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = excommunicated } }
		add = -15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { piety_level >= 3 } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = zealous } }
		add = 4
	}
}

qpq_fund_the_dawa_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 18
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 10
	}
	add = {
		value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
		multiply = -0.2
		min = -15
		max = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:actor = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
		}
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:actor } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = sadistic } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = vengeful } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = callous } }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = 3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = compassionate } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = forgiving } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = -4
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { scope:actor.faith = scope:recipient.faith } }
		add = -12
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = excommunicated } }
		add = -15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { piety_level >= 3 } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = zealous } }
		add = 4
	}
}

#### Crowning the Usurper
qpq_crowning_the_usurper_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 4
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:actor.top_liege }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:actor.top_liege } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:actor.top_liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:actor.top_liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:actor.top_liege } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:actor.top_liege } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:actor.top_liege } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_crowning_the_usurper_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 4
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_crowning_the_usurper_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_crowning_the_usurper_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 50
	}
	add = 10
	multiply = {
		value = 1
		subtract = { value = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
		min = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_crowning_the_usurper_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -15
}
qpq_crowning_the_usurper_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_demand_value
}
qpq_crowning_the_usurper_offer_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes }
			add = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_gold_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }
			add = -3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
			add = -5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_land ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_land_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_office ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_office_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_release_hook ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_release_hook_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_my_word_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_secret ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_secret_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_contract_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 70
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_crowning_the_usurper_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_crowning_the_usurper_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_crowning_the_usurper_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_crowning_the_usurper_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_crowning_the_usurper_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_crowning_the_usurper_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_ask_value
	add = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_opinion_points_value
	add = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_character_value
	add = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_dread_value
	add = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_goal_value
	add = qpq_crowning_the_usurper_refusal_value
}

	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { piety_level >= 3 } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = zealous } }
		add = 4
	}
}

#### Favourable Omens
qpq_favourable_omens_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_favourable_omens_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_favourable_omens_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_favourable_omens_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_favourable_omens_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_favourable_omens_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 50
	}
	add = 10
	multiply = {
		value = 1
		subtract = { value = qpq_favourable_omens_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
		min = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_favourable_omens_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_favourable_omens_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = 0
}
qpq_favourable_omens_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_favourable_omens_demand_value
}
qpq_favourable_omens_offer_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes }
			add = qpq_favourable_omens_gold_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }
			add = -3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
			add = -5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_land ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_land_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_office ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_office_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_release_hook ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_release_hook_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_my_word_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_secret ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_secret_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_contract_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 70
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_favourable_omens_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_favourable_omens_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_favourable_omens_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_favourable_omens_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_favourable_omens_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_favourable_omens_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_favourable_omens_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_favourable_omens_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_favourable_omens_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_favourable_omens_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_favourable_omens_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_favourable_omens_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_favourable_omens_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_favourable_omens_ask_value
	add = qpq_favourable_omens_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_opinion_points_value
	add = qpq_favourable_omens_character_value
	add = qpq_favourable_omens_dread_value
	add = qpq_favourable_omens_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_favourable_omens_goal_value
	add = qpq_favourable_omens_refusal_value
}

qpq_favourable_omens_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 18
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 10
	}
	add = {
		value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
		multiply = -0.2
		min = -15
		max = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
		}
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:recipient } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = sadistic } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = vengeful } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = callous } }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = 3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = forgiving } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = -4
	}
}

qpq_favourable_omens_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 18
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 10
	}
	add = {
		value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
		multiply = -0.2
		min = -15
		max = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:actor = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
		}
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:actor } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = sadistic } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = vengeful } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = callous } }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = 3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = compassionate } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = forgiving } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = -4
	}
}

#### Consecration Rites
qpq_consecration_rites_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:actor = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { exists = dynasty }
					dynasty = { dynasty_prestige_level <= 1 }
					primary_title.title_held_years < 5
				}
			}
		}
		add = 1
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}

	max = 5

		add = 6

			add = qpq_temple_patronage_gold_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }
			add = -3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
			add = -5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_land ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_land_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_office ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_office_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_release_hook ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_release_hook_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_my_word_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_secret ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_secret_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_contract_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 70
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_temple_patronage_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_temple_patronage_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_temple_patronage_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_temple_patronage_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_temple_patronage_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_temple_patronage_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_temple_patronage_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_temple_patronage_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_temple_patronage_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_temple_patronage_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_temple_patronage_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_temple_patronage_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_temple_patronage_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_temple_patronage_ask_value
	add = qpq_temple_patronage_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_opinion_points_value
	add = qpq_temple_patronage_character_value
	add = qpq_temple_patronage_dread_value
	add = qpq_temple_patronage_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_temple_patronage_goal_value
	add = qpq_temple_patronage_refusal_value
}

qpq_temple_patronage_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 18
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 10
	}
	add = {
		value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
		multiply = -0.2
		min = -15
		max = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
		}
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:recipient } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = sadistic } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = vengeful } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = callous } }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = 3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = compassionate } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = forgiving } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = -4
	}
}

qpq_temple_patronage_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 18
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 10
	}
	add = {
		value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
		multiply = -0.2
		min = -15
		max = 15
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = -25
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
				scope:actor = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
			}
		}
		add = -20
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:secondary_recipient = { is_liege_or_above_of = scope:actor } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = sadistic } }
		add = 8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = vengeful } }
		add = 6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = callous } }
		add = 5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = 3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = compassionate } }
		add = -8
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = forgiving } }
		add = -6
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = -4
	}
}

#### Make Peace
qpq_make_peace_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 0
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_make_peace_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_make_peace_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_make_peace_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_make_peace_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_make_peace_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 50
	}
	add = 10
	multiply = {
		value = 1
		subtract = { value = qpq_make_peace_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
		min = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_make_peace_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_make_peace_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -10
}
qpq_make_peace_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_make_peace_demand_value
}
qpq_make_peace_offer_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes }
			add = qpq_make_peace_gold_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }
			add = -3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
			add = -5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_land ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_land_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_office ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_office_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_release_hook ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_release_hook_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_my_word_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_secret ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_secret_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_contract_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }

		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }

		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value

		max = 70

		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }

			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }

		add = 60

qpq_make_peace_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_make_peace_ask_value
	add = qpq_make_peace_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_opinion_points_value
	add = qpq_make_peace_character_value
	add = qpq_make_peace_dread_value
	add = qpq_make_peace_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_make_peace_goal_value
	add = qpq_make_peace_refusal_value
}

qpq_make_peace_goal_ours_value = {
	value = 0
	scope:recipient = {
		every_character_war = {
			limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:recipient FOE = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			if = {
				limit = { is_attacker = scope:recipient }
				every_war_attacker = { add = current_military_strength }
			}
			else = {
				every_war_defender = { add = current_military_strength }
			}
		}
	}
	min = 1
}

qpq_make_peace_goal_theirs_value = {
	value = 0
	scope:recipient = {
		every_character_war = {
			limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:recipient FOE = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			if = {
				limit = { is_attacker = scope:recipient }
				every_war_defender = { add = current_military_strength }
			}
			else = {
				every_war_attacker = { add = current_military_strength }
			}
		}
	}
}

qpq_make_peace_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	add = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { any_claim = { holder ?= scope:secondary_recipient } } }
			add = 12
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:recipient.faith = {
					faith_hostility_level = {
						target = scope:secondary_recipient.faith
						value >= faith_hostile_level
					}
				}
			}
			add = 8
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			add = {
				value = ai_boldness
				multiply = 0.1
			}
			add = {
				value = ai_energy
				multiply = 0.05
			}
			add = {
				value = ai_compassion
				multiply = -0.05
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = ambitious } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = brave } }
			add = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = wrathful } }
			add = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arrogant } }
			add = 3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = content } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = craven } }
			add = -10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = calm } }
			add = -2
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			every_character_war = {
				limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:recipient FOE = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				if = {
					limit = { war_days >= 1095 }
					add = -8
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_make_peace_goal_ours_value >= { value = qpq_make_peace_goal_theirs_value multiply = 2 } }
			add = 20
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { qpq_make_peace_goal_ours_value >= { value = qpq_make_peace_goal_theirs_value multiply = 1.25 } }
			add = 10
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { qpq_make_peace_goal_ours_value < { value = qpq_make_peace_goal_theirs_value multiply = 0.5 } }
			add = -30
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { qpq_make_peace_goal_ours_value < { value = qpq_make_peace_goal_theirs_value multiply = 0.8 } }
			add = -15
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			every_character_war = {
				limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:recipient FOE = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				if = {
					limit = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:recipient SCORE = 40 } }
					add = 12
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:recipient SCORE = 15 } }
					add = 6
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { NOT = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:recipient SCORE = -40 } } }
					add = -12
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { NOT = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:recipient SCORE = -15 } } }
					add = -6
				}
			}
		}
		multiply = -0.6
	}
}

qpq_make_peace_goal_sw_ours_value = {
	value = 0
	scope:actor = {
		every_character_war = {
			limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor FOE = scope:secondary_recipient } }

			}

				every_war_defender = { add = current_military_strength }

				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { any_claim = { holder ?= scope:secondary_recipient } } }
			add = 12
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:actor.faith = {
					faith_hostility_level = {
						target = scope:secondary_recipient.faith
						value >= faith_hostile_level
					}
				}
			}
			add = 8
		}
		scope:actor = {
			add = {
				value = ai_boldness
				multiply = 0.1
			}
			add = {
				value = ai_energy
				multiply = 0.05
			}
			add = {
				value = ai_compassion
				multiply = -0.05
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = ambitious } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = brave } }
			add = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = wrathful } }
			add = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = arrogant } }
			add = 3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = content } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = craven } }
			add = -10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = calm } }
			add = -2
		}
		scope:actor = {
			every_character_war = {
				limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor FOE = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				if = {
					limit = { war_days >= 1095 }
					add = -8
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_make_peace_goal_sw_ours_value >= { value = qpq_make_peace_goal_sw_theirs_value multiply = 2 } }
			add = 20
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { qpq_make_peace_goal_sw_ours_value >= { value = qpq_make_peace_goal_sw_theirs_value multiply = 1.25 } }
			add = 10
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { qpq_make_peace_goal_sw_ours_value < { value = qpq_make_peace_goal_sw_theirs_value multiply = 0.5 } }
			add = -30
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { qpq_make_peace_goal_sw_ours_value < { value = qpq_make_peace_goal_sw_theirs_value multiply = 0.8 } }
			add = -15
		}
		scope:actor = {
			every_character_war = {
				limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor FOE = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				if = {
					limit = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor SCORE = 40 } }
					add = 12
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor SCORE = 15 } }
					add = 6
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { NOT = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor SCORE = -40 } } }
					add = -12
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { NOT = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor SCORE = -15 } } }
					add = -6
				}
			}
		}
		multiply = -0.6
	}
}

#### Yield the War
qpq_yield_war_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_yield_war_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 2
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_yield_war_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_yield_war_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_yield_war_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_yield_war_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 50
	}
	add = 10
	multiply = {
		value = 1
		subtract = { value = qpq_yield_war_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
		min = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_yield_war_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_yield_war_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -35
}
qpq_yield_war_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_yield_war_demand_value
}
qpq_yield_war_offer_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes }
			add = qpq_yield_war_gold_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }
			add = -3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
			add = -5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_land ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_land_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_office ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_office_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_release_hook ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_release_hook_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_my_word_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_secret ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_secret_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_contract_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 70
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_yield_war_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_yield_war_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_yield_war_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_yield_war_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_yield_war_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_yield_war_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_yield_war_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_yield_war_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_yield_war_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_yield_war_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_yield_war_agent_tier_value }
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_yield_war_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_yield_war_ask_value
	add = qpq_yield_war_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_opinion_points_value
	add = qpq_yield_war_character_value
	add = qpq_yield_war_dread_value
	add = qpq_yield_war_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_yield_war_goal_value
	add = qpq_yield_war_refusal_value
}

qpq_yield_war_goal_ours_value = {
	value = 0
	scope:recipient = {
		every_character_war = {
			limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:recipient FOE = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			if = {
				limit = { is_attacker = scope:recipient }
				every_war_attacker = { add = current_military_strength }
			}
			else = {
				every_war_defender = { add = current_military_strength }
			}
		}
	}
	min = 1
}

qpq_yield_war_goal_theirs_value = {
	value = 0
	scope:recipient = {
		every_character_war = {
			limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:recipient FOE = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			if = {
				limit = { is_attacker = scope:recipient }
				every_war_defender = { add = current_military_strength }
			}
			else = {
				every_war_attacker = { add = current_military_strength }
			}
		}
	}
}

qpq_yield_war_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	add = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { any_claim = { holder ?= scope:secondary_recipient } } }
			add = 12
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:recipient.faith = {
					faith_hostility_level = {
						target = scope:secondary_recipient.faith
						value >= faith_hostile_level
					}
				}
			}
			add = 8
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			add = {
				value = ai_boldness
				multiply = 0.1
			}
			add = {
				value = ai_energy
				multiply = 0.05
			}
			add = {
				value = ai_compassion
				multiply = -0.05
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = ambitious } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = brave } }
			add = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = wrathful } }
			add = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arrogant } }
			add = 3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = content } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = craven } }
			add = -10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = calm } }
			add = -2
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			every_character_war = {
				limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:recipient FOE = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				if = {
					limit = { war_days >= 1095 }
					add = -8
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_yield_war_goal_ours_value >= { value = qpq_yield_war_goal_theirs_value multiply = 2 } }
			add = 20
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { qpq_yield_war_goal_ours_value >= { value = qpq_yield_war_goal_theirs_value multiply = 1.25 } }
			add = 10
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { qpq_yield_war_goal_ours_value < { value = qpq_yield_war_goal_theirs_value multiply = 0.5 } }
			add = -30
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { qpq_yield_war_goal_ours_value < { value = qpq_yield_war_goal_theirs_value multiply = 0.8 } }
			add = -15
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			every_character_war = {
				limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:recipient FOE = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				if = {
					limit = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:recipient SCORE = 40 } }
					add = 12
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:recipient SCORE = 15 } }
					add = 6
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { NOT = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:recipient SCORE = -40 } } }
					add = -12
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { NOT = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:recipient SCORE = -15 } } }
					add = -6
				}
			}
		}
		multiply = -1.0
	}
}

#### Join the War
qpq_join_war_payer_tier_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:actor TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_join_war_agent_tier_value = {
	value = 1
	if = {
		limit = { exists = scope:secondary_recipient }
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_hostile_foreigner_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_coreligionist_ally_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_same_realm_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_close_kin_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_own_liege_trigger = { PARTY = scope:recipient TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_ctx_clergy_trigger = { TARGET = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 1
		}
	}
	min = 0
	max = 5
}
qpq_join_war_price_value = {
	value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
	multiply = {
		value = qpq_join_war_agent_tier_value
		multiply = 4
		add = 3
	}
	min = 25
	round = yes
}
qpq_join_war_gold_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:qpq_price }
			add = scope:qpq_price
		}
		else = {
			add = qpq_join_war_price_value
		}
		divide = {
			value = scope:recipient.qpq_stake_value
			multiply = 6
			min = 5
		}
		multiply = 30
		max = 50
	}
	add = 10
	multiply = {
		value = 1
		subtract = { value = qpq_join_war_agent_tier_value multiply = 0.1 }
		min = 0.5
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = greedy } }
		multiply = 1.3
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = generous } }
		multiply = 0.8
	}
	round = yes
}
qpq_join_war_demand_value = {
	value = qpq_join_war_agent_tier_value
	multiply = -18
	add = -12
	add = -20
}
qpq_join_war_ask_value = {
	value = qpq_join_war_demand_value
}
qpq_join_war_offer_points_value = {
	value = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_gold ?= yes }
			add = qpq_join_war_gold_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_on_delivery ?= yes }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_split ?= yes }
			add = -3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_stipend ?= yes }
			add = -5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_land ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_land_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_office ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_office_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_release_hook ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_release_hook_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_my_word ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_my_word_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_secret ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_secret_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_contract ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_contract_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_succession ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_succession_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_clemency ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_clemency_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_arms ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_arms_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_artifact ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_artifact_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_church ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_church_points_value
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:qpq_o_restraint ?= yes }
			add = qpq_offer_restraint_points_value
		}
		max = 70
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes }
		add = 40
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:qpq_o_hook ?= yes
			scope:actor = { has_strong_hook = scope:recipient }
		}
		add = 60
	}
}
qpq_join_war_character_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = honest } }
		add = { value = qpq_join_war_agent_tier_value multiply = -6 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = just } }
		add = { value = qpq_join_war_agent_tier_value multiply = -5 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = deceitful } }
		add = { value = qpq_join_war_agent_tier_value multiply = 4 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arbitrary } }
		add = { value = qpq_join_war_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = schemer } }
		add = { value = qpq_join_war_agent_tier_value multiply = 3 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = paranoid } }
		add = { value = qpq_join_war_agent_tier_value multiply = -3 }
	}
}
qpq_join_war_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_join_war_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient }
		}
		add = 10
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			scope:recipient = { has_trait = craven }
		}
		add = -15
	}
}
qpq_join_war_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_join_war_agent_tier_value }
				qpq_join_war_goal_refuses_trigger = yes
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_join_war_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_join_war_ask_value
	add = qpq_join_war_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_opinion_points_value
	add = qpq_join_war_character_value
	add = qpq_join_war_dread_value
	add = qpq_join_war_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_join_war_goal_value
	add = qpq_join_war_refusal_value
}

qpq_join_war_goal_ours_value = {
	value = 0
	scope:actor = {
		every_character_war = {
			limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor FOE = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			if = {
				limit = { is_attacker = scope:actor }
				every_war_attacker = { add = current_military_strength }
			}
			else = {
				every_war_defender = { add = current_military_strength }
			}
		}
	}
	add = scope:recipient.current_military_strength
	min = 1
}

qpq_join_war_goal_theirs_value = {
	value = 0
	scope:actor = {
		every_character_war = {
			limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor FOE = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			if = {
				limit = { is_attacker = scope:actor }
				every_war_defender = { add = current_military_strength }
			}
			else = {
				every_war_attacker = { add = current_military_strength }
			}
		}
	}
}

qpq_join_war_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	add = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { any_claim = { holder ?= scope:secondary_recipient } } }
			add = 12
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:recipient.faith = {
					faith_hostility_level = {
						target = scope:secondary_recipient.faith
						value >= faith_hostile_level
					}
				}
			}
			add = 8
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			add = {
				value = ai_boldness
				multiply = 0.1
			}
			add = {
				value = ai_energy
				multiply = 0.05
			}
			add = {
				value = ai_compassion
				multiply = -0.05
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = ambitious } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = brave } }
			add = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = wrathful } }
			add = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arrogant } }
			add = 3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = content } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = craven } }
			add = -10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = calm } }
			add = -2
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_at_war = yes } }
			add = -8
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_join_war_goal_ours_value >= { value = qpq_join_war_goal_theirs_value multiply = 2 } }
			add = 20
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { qpq_join_war_goal_ours_value >= { value = qpq_join_war_goal_theirs_value multiply = 1.25 } }
			add = 10
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { qpq_join_war_goal_ours_value < { value = qpq_join_war_goal_theirs_value multiply = 0.5 } }
			add = -30
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { qpq_join_war_goal_ours_value < { value = qpq_join_war_goal_theirs_value multiply = 0.8 } }
			add = -15
		}
		scope:actor = {
			every_character_war = {
				limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor FOE = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				if = {
					limit = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor SCORE = 40 } }
					add = 12
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor SCORE = 15 } }
					add = 6
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { NOT = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor SCORE = -40 } } }
					add = -12
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { NOT = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor SCORE = -15 } } }
					add = -6
				}
			}
		}
		multiply = 1.0
	}
}

qpq_join_war_goal_sw_ours_value = {
	value = 0
	scope:recipient = {
		every_character_war = {
			limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:recipient FOE = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			if = {

			}

				every_war_defender = { add = current_military_strength }

		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = wrathful } }
			add = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = arrogant } }
			add = 3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = content } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = craven } }
			add = -10

			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = calm } }

		}

			limit = { scope:actor = { is_at_war = yes } }
			add = -8

		if = {
			limit = { qpq_join_war_goal_sw_ours_value >= { value = qpq_join_war_goal_sw_theirs_value multiply = 2 } }
			add = 20
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { qpq_join_war_goal_sw_ours_value >= { value = qpq_join_war_goal_sw_theirs_value multiply = 1.25 } }
			add = 10
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { qpq_join_war_goal_sw_ours_value < { value = qpq_join_war_goal_sw_theirs_value multiply = 0.5 } }
			add = -30
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { qpq_join_war_goal_sw_ours_value < { value = qpq_join_war_goal_sw_theirs_value multiply = 0.8 } }
			add = -15
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			every_character_war = {
				limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:recipient FOE = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				if = {
					limit = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:recipient SCORE = 40 } }
					add = 12
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:recipient SCORE = 15 } }
					add = 6
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { NOT = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:recipient SCORE = -40 } } }
					add = -12
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { NOT = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:recipient SCORE = -15 } } }
					add = -6
				}
			}
		}
		multiply = 1.0
	}
}

	max = 5

	max = 5

qpq_leave_war_dread_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 1 } } }
		add = intimidated_halved_reason_value
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:recipient = { has_dread_level_towards = { target = scope:actor level = 2 } } }
		add = cowed_halved_reason_value
	}
}
qpq_leave_war_circumstance_value = {
	value = 0
}
qpq_leave_war_refusal_value = {
	value = 0
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				qpq_ai_refuses_trigger = { AGENT = scope:recipient PAYER = scope:actor TIER = qpq_leave_war_agent_tier_value }
				always = no
			}
		}
		add = -1000
	}
}
qpq_leave_war_ai_acceptance_value = {
	value = qpq_leave_war_ask_value
	add = qpq_leave_war_offer_points_value
	add = qpq_opinion_points_value
	add = qpq_leave_war_character_value
	add = qpq_leave_war_dread_value
	add = qpq_leave_war_circumstance_value
	add = qpq_leave_war_goal_value
	add = qpq_leave_war_refusal_value
}

qpq_leave_war_goal_ours_value = {
	value = 0
	scope:recipient = {
		every_character_war = {
			limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:recipient FOE = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			if = {
				limit = { is_attacker = scope:recipient }
				every_war_attacker = { add = current_military_strength }
			}
			else = {
				every_war_defender = { add = current_military_strength }
			}
		}
	}
	min = 1
}

qpq_leave_war_goal_theirs_value = {
	value = 0
	scope:recipient = {
		every_character_war = {
			limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:recipient FOE = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			if = {
				limit = { is_attacker = scope:recipient }
				every_war_defender = { add = current_military_strength }
			}
			else = {
				every_war_attacker = { add = current_military_strength }
			}
		}
	}
}

qpq_leave_war_goal_value = {
	value = 0
	add = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:recipient.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:recipient = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { any_claim = { holder ?= scope:secondary_recipient } } }
			add = 12
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:recipient.faith = {
					faith_hostility_level = {
						target = scope:secondary_recipient.faith
						value >= faith_hostile_level
					}
				}
			}
			add = 8
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			add = {
				value = ai_boldness
				multiply = 0.1
			}
			add = {
				value = ai_energy
				multiply = 0.05
			}
			add = {
				value = ai_compassion
				multiply = -0.05
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = ambitious } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = brave } }
			add = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = wrathful } }
			add = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = arrogant } }
			add = 3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = content } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = craven } }
			add = -10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:recipient = { has_trait = calm } }
			add = -2
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			every_character_war = {
				limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:recipient FOE = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				if = {
					limit = { war_days >= 1095 }
					add = -8
				}
			}
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			every_character_war = {
				limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:recipient FOE = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_attacker = scope:recipient
						primary_attacker = { is_allied_to = scope:recipient }
					}
					add = 15
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						is_defender = scope:recipient
						primary_defender = { is_allied_to = scope:recipient }
					}
					add = 15
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_leave_war_goal_ours_value >= { value = qpq_leave_war_goal_theirs_value multiply = 2 } }
			add = 20
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { qpq_leave_war_goal_ours_value >= { value = qpq_leave_war_goal_theirs_value multiply = 1.25 } }
			add = 10
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { qpq_leave_war_goal_ours_value < { value = qpq_leave_war_goal_theirs_value multiply = 0.5 } }
			add = -30
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { qpq_leave_war_goal_ours_value < { value = qpq_leave_war_goal_theirs_value multiply = 0.8 } }
			add = -15
		}
		scope:recipient = {
			every_character_war = {
				limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:recipient FOE = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				if = {
					limit = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:recipient SCORE = 40 } }
					add = 12
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:recipient SCORE = 15 } }
					add = 6
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { NOT = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:recipient SCORE = -40 } } }
					add = -12
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { NOT = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:recipient SCORE = -15 } } }
					add = -6
				}
			}
		}
		multiply = -0.6
	}
}

qpq_leave_war_goal_sw_ours_value = {
	value = 0
	scope:actor = {
		every_character_war = {
			limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor FOE = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			if = {
				limit = { is_attacker = scope:actor }
				every_war_attacker = { add = current_military_strength }
			}
			else = {
				every_war_defender = { add = current_military_strength }
			}
		}
	}
	min = 1
}

	value = 0
	scope:actor = {
		every_character_war = {
			limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor FOE = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			if = {
				limit = { is_attacker = scope:actor }
				every_war_defender = { add = current_military_strength }
			}
			else = {
				every_war_attacker = { add = current_military_strength }
			}
		}
	}

qpq_leave_war_goal_sw_value = {
	value = 0
	add = {
		value = 0
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_rival = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 18
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_nemesis = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 10
		}
		add = {
			value = "scope:actor.opinion(scope:secondary_recipient)"
			multiply = -0.2
			min = -15
			max = 15
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_allied_to = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { is_close_family_of = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = -25
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					scope:actor = { has_relation_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_lover = scope:secondary_recipient }
					scope:actor = { has_relation_best_friend = scope:secondary_recipient }
				}
			}
			add = -20
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_relation_victim = scope:secondary_recipient } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { any_claim = { holder ?= scope:secondary_recipient } } }
			add = 12
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:actor.faith = {
					faith_hostility_level = {
						target = scope:secondary_recipient.faith
						value >= faith_hostile_level
					}
				}
			}
			add = 8
		}
		scope:actor = {
			add = {
				value = ai_boldness
				multiply = 0.1
			}
			add = {
				value = ai_energy
				multiply = 0.05
			}
			add = {
				value = ai_compassion
				multiply = -0.05
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = ambitious } }
			add = 6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = brave } }
			add = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = wrathful } }
			add = 4
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = arrogant } }
			add = 3
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = content } }
			add = -6
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = craven } }
			add = -10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { scope:actor = { has_trait = calm } }
			add = -2
		}
		scope:actor = {
			every_character_war = {
				limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor FOE = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				if = {
					limit = { war_days >= 1095 }
					add = -8
				}
			}
		}
		scope:actor = {
			every_character_war = {
				limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor FOE = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_attacker = scope:actor
						primary_attacker = { is_allied_to = scope:actor }
					}
					add = 15
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						is_defender = scope:actor
						primary_defender = { is_allied_to = scope:actor }
					}
					add = 15
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { qpq_leave_war_goal_sw_ours_value >= { value = qpq_leave_war_goal_sw_theirs_value multiply = 2 } }
			add = 20
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { qpq_leave_war_goal_sw_ours_value >= { value = qpq_leave_war_goal_sw_theirs_value multiply = 1.25 } }
			add = 10
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { qpq_leave_war_goal_sw_ours_value < { value = qpq_leave_war_goal_sw_theirs_value multiply = 0.5 } }
			add = -30
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { qpq_leave_war_goal_sw_ours_value < { value = qpq_leave_war_goal_sw_theirs_value multiply = 0.8 } }
			add = -15
		}
		scope:actor = {
			every_character_war = {
				limit = { qpq_war_foe_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor FOE = scope:secondary_recipient } }
				if = {
					limit = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor SCORE = 40 } }
					add = 12
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor SCORE = 15 } }
					add = 6
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { NOT = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor SCORE = -40 } } }
					add = -12
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { NOT = { qpq_war_side_winning_trigger = { WHO = scope:actor SCORE = -15 } } }
					add = -6
				}
			}
		}
		multiply = -0.6
	}
